description: This Java class implements a custom password strength validator using the Zxcvbn library, intended to be used as a validation constraint in a Java application.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if a password meets a specified strength level using the Zxcvbn library.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the password strength requirement from the annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided password meets the strength criteria.
